title: Simple Plate Transfer - 6 Sources
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later), P300 multi‑channel pipette, NEST 96‑well deepwell plate (2 mL capacity), and Greiner Microlon 96‑well plate (340 µL capacity). This protocol creates a custom plate‑filling method that transfers liquid from 1 source plate to up to 9 destination plates (up to 6 sources) using the P300‑multi channel pipette.

steps.title: Define protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, input your protocol parameters such as number of sources (up to 6), number of destination plates (up to 9), source and destination labware types, and any volume settings required for the transfer.

steps.title: Generate protocol file
steps.instruction: After entering the parameters, click the button to download your protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Load protocol into OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT‑2 Run App and use the “Upload protocol” function to upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck according to the provided deck map, placing the source plate, destination plates, tip rack, and any other required labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 Run App, calibrate the positions of the labware, tip rack, and the P300‑multi channel pipette. Refer to the OT‑2 support articles for detailed calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Execute the run
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT‑2 Run App to start the plate‑transfer protocol.
